# xqclip browser assets

- Package: `xqclip@0.1.3`
- Source: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/xqclip>
- Browser entry: `lib/js/xqclip.min.js` (`window.xqclip`)
- Stylesheet: `lib/css/xqclip.min.css`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

The case keeps the published UMD build unchanged. `js/demo.js` applies a
case-level pointer compatibility patch because the preview iframe is narrower
than the package's 768px touch-device breakpoint.
